titulo: Quiz — Stop at the extra line
introPt: A traveller receives a bill with an extra tip line before the card terminal arrives. Listen for the review sequence and the amount that is actually authorised.
cenario: The bill is checked, corrected and only then transferred to the terminal.

dialogo.pt: Can you bring me the bill, please?

dialogo.es: No autoricé este cargo. ¿Puede quitarlo, por favor?
dialogo.pt: I did not authorise this charge. Can you remove it, please?

dialogo.es: Quiero agregar esta cantidad de propina. ¿Me trae la terminal, por favor?
dialogo.pt: I want to add this amount as a tip. Can you bring me the terminal, please?

perguntas.explica: The bill is the surface where the traveller checks and authorises the amount.
The traveller points to an unknown line and asks what the charge is.
A voluntary tip requires the diner's choice; this line was added without consent.

perguntas.pergunta: Did the traveller refuse every tip?
opcoes: No; a chosen amount was added after correction
perguntas.explica: Removing an unauthorised line and choosing a voluntary amount are separate actions.

opcoes: The corrected bill and terminal amount
perguntas.explica: The terminal should display the amount the traveller actually approved.
